headline: Spain stride on, England bow out and Nana clings on
text: Spain (Grandad) have done the business, seeing off France (Carolina), while Argentina (Nana) edged England (Alex) to send the England camp home with a grimace. The only real consolation for Nana was a draw with Switzerland (Jack), which kept things respectable but hardly glamorous. Up top, Max is still best overall on 30 points, with Grandad snapping at the heels on 29. At the other end, Sofia remains worst overall on 10 points, with Christopher next in the scrap heap on 11. A tidy little run for Grandad, a nasty one for Alex, and the table still has a distinctly cheeky look about it.
